finding.title: Localize CityPickerScreen's hardcoded English idle-hint text (_IdleHint)

evidence.quote:
'Start typing to search ~33,000 cities.\n'
          'Type at least 2 letters.',

finding.why: This paragraph is the screen's default state (shown whenever the query is under 2 chars) — every Hebrew-locale user sees it first, not as an edge case. No ARB key exists for it in app_en.arb/app_he.arb, so make arb-parity can't catch it. The file's own RTL smoke test ('idle hint renders without overflow under he locale') only asserts no overflow/ErrorWidget, never the text itself, so the defect has zero regression coverage despite the rest of the screen being fully localized.
finding.recommendation: Add a cityPickerIdleHint-style ICU string to app_en.arb/app_he.arb and render it via AppLocalizations instead of the literal; extend the he-locale test to assert the Hebrew string renders (and the English literal does not).
acceptance_criteria: New ARB key added to app_en.arb and app_he.arb and used in _IdleHint
city_picker_screen_l1_test.dart's he-locale idle-hint test asserts the Hebrew string is shown, not just absence of overflow
